content.value: Using a diffractometer and a radiation of wavelength 1.54 Å, a reflection from an FCC crystal (10) is observed when 2θ is 121°. Calculate the indices(hkl) of this reflection. What is the spacing between planes of the crystal from which this reflection originates?
